paper.title: Two-dimensional Hyperbolic RNN Neural Quantum State

extraction_model: ChatGPT Work assisted extraction with deterministic table parsing; no model API

results.system_description: Square 8x8 transverse-field Ising model, open boundaries, H=-J sum_<ij> sigma_z(i)sigma_z(j)-Bx sum_i sigma_x(i); J=1, Bx=3; horizontal/vertical nearest neighbors, Pauli sigma convention (Eq. 17); no fixed Sz sector.
results.source_location: Table 2, Euclidean 2DRNN, Best energy and sampling error; Eq. 17
results.eligibility_evidence: Sections 3-5: original VMC estimates of autoregressive real neural wavefunctions; selected Best column/rows, without extrapolation or projection. Table caption identifies the uncertainty as the VMC sampling standard error.
results.notes: Best initialization run, not the average across initializations. Energy variance not tabulated. Pauli normalization and the negative bond/field signs follow Eq. 17 and the author code. On this bipartite open square lattice, the positive-sign Varbench Hamiltonian is related by sublattice spin flips and a global field-sign rotation, with no energy rescaling or shift.
